selection_reasoning: I selected 'mine dark_oak_sign' as the single atomic task. This task is straightforward and observable: the agent needs to find and mine (break) a dark_oak_sign placed in the scene. It requires no deep Minecraft domain knowledge beyond knowing how to break a block, and the completion is easily verifiable by checking if the sign block has been removed or if the item has entered the agent's inventory. As a single task, no multi-hop dependency is needed, but the scene must contain a dark_oak_sign placed in a visible and accessible location.

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when a dark_oak_sign block is mined (broken), it drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with only a wooden_axe, so having a dark_oak_sign in inventory is definitive proof the sign was successfully mined. Signs break instantly with any tool or bare hands.

scene_description: A cleared grass platform (11x11 blocks) in a dark oak forest biome with a single dark_oak_sign placed 4 blocks ahead of the player spawn. The player is given a wooden_axe to mine the sign efficiently. The area is cleared of trees and obstacles to ensure the sign is visible and accessible.
task_text: Find and mine the dark_oak_sign placed on the grass platform ahead of you. Use the wooden_axe in your inventory to break it.
design_notes: The sign is placed at ~0 ~0 ~4 (4 blocks in front of spawn on the Z-axis). rotation=8 means the sign faces south (toward the player), making it visible from spawn. The 11x11 cleared area ensures no tree trunks or leaves block the path. The wooden_axe speeds up mining but isn't strictly required - signs can be broken by hand. The /fill air command clears from y+0 to y+4 to remove any tree canopy overhead.
